name: cybercoder-cli
description: CyberCoder CLI — fullstack agentic coding assistant by Codeva

scripts.compile: npm run build && npm run build:rpc && node scripts/compile-binary.mjs
scripts.compile:win: npm run build && npm run build:rpc && node scripts/compile-binary.mjs --target win
scripts.compile:mac: npm run build && npm run build:rpc && node scripts/compile-binary.mjs --target mac
scripts.compile:linux: npm run build && npm run build:rpc && node scripts/compile-binary.mjs --target linux
scripts.test: tsx --test src/components/ModelPicker.test.ts src/commands/ecosystem.test.ts src/commands/compact.test.ts src/commands/skills-catalog.test.ts src/commands/worktree.test.ts src/runtime/hooks.test.ts src/runtime/subagent-write.test.ts src/utils/model-access.test.ts src/rpc-server.test.ts
